```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(deeptime)

# Technology palette for facet strips
technology_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)

lab_text_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#FFFFFF",
  "ONT cDNA" = "#FFFFFF",
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#FFFFFF",
  "Kinnex"   = "#FFFFFF",
  "Bambu" = "#000000",
  "FLAIR"    = "#000000",
  "IsoQuant" = "#000000",
  "Kallisto" = "#000000",
  "Oarfish"  = "#000000"
)

# Standard normalization color palette
color_palette <- c(
  "CPM" = "#767676",
  "TPM" = "#33B5A5",
  "cqn" = "#B64342",
  "EDA" = "#E28E2C",
  "ratio_counts" = "#7570B3"
)

# Strict Nature-style theme with optimized vertical strip margins to prevent clipping
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())
```

```{r load_data}
read_dataset <- function(manifest_file, dataset){
  input_files <- read.delim(manifest_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  l_files <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(input_files)){
    input_path <- input_files[i,1]
    technology <- input_files[i,2]
    df <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$dataset <- dataset
    df$technology <- gsub("_", " ", technology)
    l_files[[input_path]] <- df
  }
  all_data <- do.call(rbind, l_files)
  return(all_data)
}

datasets <- c("NIH", "Neuron", "LongBench")
l_data <- list()
for (dataset in datasets){
  manifest_file <- paste0("data/length_", dataset, ".fofn")
  l_data[[dataset]] <- read_dataset(manifest_file, dataset)
}
all_data <- do.call(rbind, l_data)
all_data$dataset[all_data$dataset == "NIH"] <- "Mouse"

# Filter condition for supplementary Kidney analysis (Kidney, LUAD, E3)
all_data <- all_data[all_data$Condition %in% c("Kidney", "LUAD", "E3"),]
all_data$Length_bins <- factor(all_data$Length_bins, levels = unique(all_data$Length_bins))
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      Tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    ),
    Tool = factor(Tool, levels = c("Bambu", "FLAIR", "IsoQuant", "Kallisto", "Oarfish"))
  )
```

```{r generate_plots}
l_plots <- list()
dataset_titles <- c("Mouse" = "Mouse (Kidney)", "LongBench" = "LongBench (LUAD)", "Neuron" = "iNeurons (E3)")
datasets <- c("Mouse", "LongBench", "Neuron")

for (my_dataset in datasets){
  l_plots[[my_dataset]] <- all_data %>% 
    filter(dataset == my_dataset) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Length_bins, y = mean_exp, color = Normalization, group = Normalization)) +
    
    # Elegant, delicate line width
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    # Structuring by platform/technology and computational tool
    facet_grid_color(technology ~ Tool, scales = "free", colors = technology_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) +
    
    # Custom color palette and labels
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color_palette,
      labels = c("CPM" = "CPM", "TPM" = "TPM", "cqn" = "CQN", "EDA" = "EDASeq", "ratio_counts" = "SMR")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Transcript Length", 
      y = "Mean Normalized Expression",
      title = dataset_titles[my_dataset]
    ) +
    
    theme_nature() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.0), # Shrink x-labels to fit length bins
      legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "plain", margin = margin(b = 2))
    )
}
```

```{r assemble}
# Stacking all datasets vertically with patchwork (Nature tags)
fig2_kidney <- (l_plots$Mouse / l_plots$LongBench / l_plots$Neuron + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
```

```{r export}
# Professional high-impact export function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 220, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  
  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

save_pub_r(fig2_kidney, "plots/Supplementary_Figure_9", height_mm = 220)
```
